confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of US Sun Belt city pricing, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings with events, conventions, and summer demand. Beer and cocktail figures are estimated from typical US restaurant pricing. Tip is excluded from restaurant anchors per the definitions, and sales tax is included only where the definition calls for it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized US Sun Belt and Texas cities such as Houston, Dallas, and Phoenix, placed somewhat below Austin on dining and hotel prices.
